extracted.name: Batter Fried Chicken
extracted.description: Full of taste with herbs and spices. A wonderful recipe that everyone loved!!!
ingredient_lines: 5 pounds chicken breast boneless and skin off
as needed salt to coat chicken
As needed peanut oil to fry chicken in
instruction_lines: Mix the batter till a consistency that coats the chicken and doesn't completely run off when picked up. Allow to marinate for 1 hour. Heat the oil. Take the chicken out of the batter allow some of the excessive batter to drip off and fry.
Turn as needed. When chicken is done move to a paper towels to absorb excessive amounts of oil. Repeat till all the chicken is done.
Note if batter is too thick after it has marinated add more coconut milk or a little water to loosen it up.
